title: Rethinking Negative Prompting for Concept Suppression: Unconditional Anchoring and Localized Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2412.07658v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models have rapidly transitioned from research prototypes to widely deployed tools. Along with their impressive capabilities, these models can also generate harmful or undesirable content (e.g., NSFW imagery), motivating practical mechanisms for removing such concepts. Negative prompting, which uses the negative-prompt prediction as the guidance anchor, is among the most widely used mechanisms for steering sampling trajectories away from unwanted concepts. translated_title: 重新思考用于概念抑制的负向提示：无条件锚定与局部化引导
translated_abstract: 文生图扩散模型已迅速从研究原型转变为被广泛部署的工具。在具备强大能力的同时，这些模型也可能生成有害或不良内容（例如NSFW图像），这促使人们需要实用的机制来移除此类概念。负向提示利用负向提示的预测作为引导锚点，是将采样轨迹引导远离不需要概念的最常用机制之一。然而，面对越狱提示，它可能在我们称之为“引导崩塌”的情形下失效：模型对正向提示和负向提示的去噪预测变得相似，使得驱动负向提示的引导差异消失，引导后的预测退化为负向提示的预测，从而削弱了概念抑制效果。为解决这一问题，我们提出了TraSCE（Trajectory Steering for ConcEpt Suppression，用于概念抑制的轨迹引导），这是一种无需训练的方法……
tldr: 提出无需训练的TraSCE方法，通过无条件锚定与局部化引导，解决负向提示在越狱攻击下因“引导崩塌”而失效的问题，从而有效抑制文生图模型生成有害或不良概念。
en_tdlr: We propose TraSCE, a training-free method that employs unconditional anchoring and localized guidance to overcome "guidance collapse" in negative prompting, enabling effective suppression of harmful or undesirable concepts under jailbreak prompts.
